Name: CFI software algorithm in OT firmware
Description: TitanCFI: Control-Flow Integrity monitor built on the OpenTitan Root-of-Trust. CVA6 is extended with a software-configurable stage that filters CFI-relevant instructions and forwards them into a private mailbox (configurable queue depth); a computational element in OpenTitan reads the instruction stream and enforces the CFI policy, with OpenTitan crypto accelerators authenticating CFI data structures in main memory. FPGA-implemented on VCU118, overhead measured on a benchmark set.
Comment: ISOLDE WI ID 4.2.08; related to the TitanCFI hardware unit (ips/rot-titancfi.json).
